scope: Exactly 125 runs/**/provenance.jsonl files, plus explicitly identified frozen component controls and implementation/tests. Direct post-run scores are separate from ordered live stage entry.

selection.rule: Every file named provenance.jsonl recursively under lab/runs, sorted by path at audit freeze; no outcome-based filtering

classification_rule.priority: Use the nearest ancestor with qualifying declarations in summary.json, manifest.json or plan.json. Explicit real_llm booleans qualify; mode=live-groq is a legacy true fallback. Stop at that ancestor.
classification_rule.real_llm: All qualifying declarations at the selected ancestor are true.
classification_rule.scripted_transport: All qualifying declarations at the selected ancestor are false. Offline controls can still use a real local encoder.
classification_rule.unknown_or_conflicting: Retain separately; never infer execution mode from directory names. None occur here.
classification_rule.limit: Recorded runner declarations are classification evidence, not independent provider authentication.

counting_rule.unit: Stored source/selected-argument pair occurrence; direct_visible_source and restored_lineage origins retained separately.
counting_rule.entry: stage.status=scored; complete/untruncated scored entries counted separately. All disabled, missing, failed, unavailable, not-applicable and skipped statuses remain in status counts.
counting_rule.first_hit: Recorded first_matched_tier; null mapped to none. Scored negative semantic entry is not a hit.
counting_rule.profile: metadata.profile when present; omitted legacy ordinary metadata means ordinary.
counting_rule.denominator_limit: Engineering inventory only; repeated tasks, source occurrences, profile evaluations and restored comparisons are not independent statistical samples. Batch grouping is retained and rates are not pooled.

profile_selection.memory: Adapter-validated restored ancestry; not offered as a direct runtime TOML profile.
profile_selection.implicit_string: Caller-declared direct profile, not chosen from source content or evaluation labels.
profile_selection.safe_control: Caller-declared direct profile, not chosen from source content or evaluation labels.

offline_real_encoder_controls.limit: Counts recomputed from frozen results; this audit did not initialize or invoke an encoder.

tier1.status: Implemented; scripted native hits and marker restoration; real scored comparisons but no real first hit found.

tier2.status: Implemented; real-agent ordered entry and hits.

tier3.status: Implemented; real encoder component and negative ordered paths, scripted native positive route; no real-agent ordered entry found.

tier4.status: Implemented with disclosed chunking/coverage choices; real encoder components and negative ordered paths, scripted native positive route; no real-agent ordered entry found.

profiles.status: All four implemented and boundary-tested; no saved implicit_string or safe_control runtime records found.

dcpg_memory.status: Cloud-drive adapter and real two-session exact-copy ancestry verified; broader adapters absent and semantic transformed-memory effectiveness not established.

reference_controls.status: Frozen program-origin and authored semantic diagnostics; not independent human or hidden-reliance ground truth.

findings.observation: All Tier1-4 algorithms and all four named threshold profiles exist. Missing real-stage coverage is not absent detector code.
Evaluation pilot records 20 scored Tier1 comparisons; the separate input-comparison batch records 10. All miss before Tier2 hits. Scripted native controls have Tier1 hits.
No scored ordered Tier3/Tier4 stage or Tier1 first hit appears in the 73 classified real-LLM provenance files.

The fixed 84-slot local-MiniLM reference run enters Tier3 and Tier4 twice per ordinary/memory/safe_control profile and five times each under implicit_string. No Tier3/Tier4 first hit occurs. These are not agent executions.
Four native rewrite runs read file1 only, create the requested file and finish. File2 is unexposed and unavailable, not a true negative. All four bound pairs first hit Tier2.

The live four-process paired pilot validates exact copy ancestry through two sessions per branch. Two restored comparisons first hit Tier2; semantic threshold 0.85 is unexercised. NTREF is passive task-data text, not the registered Canary/Tier1 mechanism.
Implicit/safe profiles are explicit caller choices; no automatic per-source implicit/safe classifier exists. A separate paper review must determine whether such a classifier is required.

No memory adapters for Mem0, external databases, calendar/inbox, cross-store copying, arbitrary overwrites or unobserved external updates. Native cloud-drive create/append/delete and exact-bound retrieval are supported.

Two authored paraphrase references miss fixed direct semantic thresholds; all six declared other-origin controls match. This is reference-specific evidence, not independently labeled hidden-model attribution or a confirmed novel research gap.

finite_completion_recommendations: Separate paper-to-code conformance, deterministic branch execution, real-encoder components, real-agent stage coverage and efficacy instead of assigning one overall percentage.
Finish a finite predeclared runtime schedule with exercised, failed, unknown or unexercised outcomes for every slot; do not rerun until a desired branch or favorable result appears.
No late-stage entry is a coverage outcome. Provider errors, omitted source reads and parser restrictions are setup/runtime issues, not automatically a method counterexample.

A counterexample must identify its exact claimed property and reference contract, retain original inputs/thresholds/statuses/hashes, and distinguish semantic relation from source origin and hidden causal reliance.
Independent human accuracy and arbitrary backend support are separate deliverables; do not silently require them for bounded engineering conformance or silently claim them complete.
limits: Tier4 chunking/coverage and 256-token behavior are disclosed local choices; this audit does not certify original-author equivalence.
The absence of real Tier1 hits, ordered Tier3/Tier4 entry and implicit/safe executions is bounded to this frozen inventory.
Real cross-session memory evidence concerns exact authorized native file copying; transformed semantic memory, longer real chains and broader backends remain unvalidated or unsupported.
Similarity candidates, graph paths, maliciousness, task success and causal reliance remain distinct. Hashes establish consistency, not authenticity against coordinated rewriting.
The auditor authored the separate 16 semantic references. This receipt is an independently implemented record inventory, not independent human label adjudication.
